description: Wave 6D-9 strictly read-only console probes (57 probes across 4 batches) covering quests, stages, objectives, targets, delays, variables, and events; dialogue, Say/SayTo, topics/infos, notes, radios, talking activators, and disposition; locks, terminals, doors, destruction, activators, and containers/inventory; and merchants, barter, vendor services, item values/health, repair lists, casinos, and economy GMSTs.

probes.expected: Record running/completed/completedAlt/failed flags across initial -> StartQuest -> CompleteQuest -> StopQuest -> ResetQuest -> StartQuest -> FailQuest -> ResetQuest on VMS04 (0x000E37E7).
